headline.title: At AI Summit, South Korea Outlines Its AI Future With NVIDIA and Partners
headline.summary: At the AI Summit in San Francisco, South Korean President Jae Myung Lee, along with business leaders and researchers, is collaborating with NVIDIA and partners to outline the country's AI development strategy. This initiative follows NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's recent visit to South Korea, emphasizing the nation's commitment to advancing its AI capabilities.

articles.title: Autonomous disproofs of the sum-product conjecture over $\mathbb R$ with GPT-5.5 Pro
articles.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.5 Pro has been utilized to autonomously disprove the Erdős–Szemerédi sum-product conjecture over the real numbers, following its previous success with the unit distance conjecture. The approach involved a three-stage prompting pipeline that included proof-plan proposal, proof construction, and review, demonstrating the potential of AI in mathematical research.

articles.title: AI-Driven Multi-Hop Relay Selection for Smart Urban NR-V2X Networks via Learning-to-Optimize Graph Neural Networks
articles.summary: The article presents a novel approach using Graph Neural Networks to optimize multi-hop relay selection in NR-V2X networks, addressing challenges such as limited RSU density and dynamic vehicular environments. This AI-driven method aims to enhance reliable and low-latency communications for Connected and Automated Vehicles in urban settings.

articles.title: EmoAgent-R1: Towards Multimodal Emotion Understanding with Reinforcement Learning-based Dynamic Agent Specialization
articles.summary: The paper introduces EmoAgent-R1, a reinforcement learning-based approach aimed at enhancing multimodal emotion understanding by allowing dynamic agent specialization. This method addresses the limitations of existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that rely on fixed prompts, thereby improving the recognition of complex emotions in diverse inputs such as video and natural language.

articles.title: Faster IndexTTS-2: Accelerating and Streaming Autoregressive Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech Synthesis on GPUs
articles.summary: The article introduces IndexTTS-2, an advanced autoregressive text-to-speech model that combines a GPT, flow-matching Diffusion Transformer, and vocoder to enhance synthesis quality. It addresses the challenge of slow inference speeds in autoregressive models, aiming to improve deployment in low-latency production applications.

articles.title: Safeguards for Speech2Speech LLM-Assistants: A Case Study in Automotive Applications
articles.summary: The article examines the integration of speech-to-speech conversational assistants in automotive applications, highlighting their ability to create natural interactions with non-verbal cues. It also addresses the challenges of implementing domain-specific safeguards within these end-to-end systems and proposes two potential approaches for their integration.

articles.title: LLM-INSTRUCT at UZH Shared Task 2026: Constraint-Aware Retrieval and Selective Debate for Paragraph-Level Argument Mining
articles.summary: The LLM-INSTRUCT system won the UZH Shared Task at ArgMining 2026, focusing on paragraph-level argument mining in UN and UNESCO resolutions. It employs constrained structured prediction for tasks such as paragraph-type classification and directed relation prediction, utilizing open-weight models with up to 8 billion parameters.

articles.title: Learn2Zinc: Fine-tuning Small Language Models for Text-to-Model Translation in MiniZinc
articles.summary: The study presented in arXiv:2607.20456v1 explores the fine-tuning of small language models to improve their ability to translate natural language problem descriptions into MiniZinc, a domain-specific constraint modeling language. The research demonstrates that targeted fine-tuning can enhance the generation of syntactically correct and semantically valid MiniZinc models.

articles.title: DS@GT ARC at ImageCLEFmed GANs 2026: Geometric Filtering for Privacy-Preserving CT Slice Generation
articles.summary: The DS@GT ARC team has developed a privacy-preserving framework for generating synthetic lung CT slices, aimed at the ImageCLEFmed GANs 2026 challenge. Their method integrates Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching with a filtering process that utilizes learned geometric latent spaces and advanced statistical techniques.

articles.title: Sparse Concept Channels in Frozen 3D CT Vision Encoders
articles.summary: A study on the 3D chest vision-language model Pillar-0 reveals that each radiological finding is represented by a sparse set of approximately 10 channels within its frozen vision embeddings. This research enhances understanding of how clinical information is encoded in large vision-language models used for 3D medical image interpretation.

articles.title: Hardware-Software Co-Design for Float16 On-Device Training on RISC-V Single-Core
articles.summary: This article presents an open-source framework for on-device training using Float16 on resource-constrained RISC-V single-core processors, leveraging standard RISC-V extensions to reduce memory footprint by approximately 50% compared to Float32. The framework also supports transfer learning and fine-tuning with minimal degradation in model performance.

articles.title: Case study: proving sqrt(2) irrational with LPTP and an LLM
articles.summary: The article discusses a case study using a Large Language Model (LLM) in conjunction with the Logic Program Theorem Prover (LPTP) to demonstrate the irrationality of the square root of 2 within a logic programming framework. It outlines the process of defining basic predicates and employing natural deduction to create human-readable proofs.
